en_title: PlayStation Plus Game Catalog for August 2026 Confirmed
cn_title: 索尼确认8月PlayStation Plus游戏目录
subtitle: 本月阵容很强
opus_summary: 索尼确认2026年8月PlayStation Plus游戏目录，《绝地潜兵2》和《天国：拯救2》领衔。美国、英国、日本将分批上线，其他地区7月21日开放完整阵容。

paragraphs.en: Sony has confirmed the PlayStation Plus Game Catalog for August 2026, which is headlined by Helldivers 2, Kingdom Come: Deliverance 2, and Vampire Survivors.
paragraphs.cn: 索尼确认了2026年8月PlayStation Plus游戏目录，领衔作品包括《绝地潜兵2》、《天国：拯救2》和《吸血鬼幸存者》。

paragraphs.en: It's a strong month, which also includes Hell is Us, Two Point Museum and Umamusume Pretty Derby - Party Dash, plus a couple of retro classics.
paragraphs.cn: 本月阵容颇为丰富，还包括《Hell is Us》、《双点博物馆》和《Umamusume Pretty Derby - Party Dash》，以及两款复古经典作品。

paragraphs.en: As ever, it's worth remembering that Sony is still experimenting with the timing of new PS Plus game releases, which means the games will be released on varying dates throughout the month if you're in the U.S., the UK and Japan. The full lineup will be available to play on July 21 in all other regions.
paragraphs.cn: 和往常一样，需要注意的是，索尼仍在尝试调整新PS Plus游戏的发行时间。这意味着，如果你身处美国、英国或日本，相关游戏会在本月不同日期陆续上线。其他地区则可在7月21日游玩完整阵容。

paragraphs.en: Earlier today, Helldivers 2 was confirmed for PlayStation Plus alongside a major new update and its long-awaited Warhammer 40,000 crossover Warbond. Here's the rest of the lineup, courtesy of the PlayStation Blog .
paragraphs.cn: 就在今天早些时候，《绝地潜兵2》已确认加入PlayStation Plus，同时还将推出重大更新，以及期待已久的《战锤40K》联动战争债券。以下是PlayStation Blog提供的其余阵容。
